page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r5.16xlarge is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance based on the KVM hypervisor. It is equipped with 64 dedicated vCPUs utilizing the x86_64 architecture. The processing power is delivered by Intel Xeon 8163 processors operating at a base frequency of 2.5 GHz.

The instance features 512.0 GB of system memory, which establishes a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core. This resource density is designed specifically for memory-intensive applications. There is no local storage included on the instance, meaning all storage requirements must be met via network-attached block storage.

Networking capabilities include a baseline network bandwidth of 20 Gbps. From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated CPU allocation combined with high memory density provides a stable environment for enterprise applications, balancing compute and memory resources without the overhead of local storage maintenance.

Given the 512.0 GB memory capacity and 64 dedicated vCPUs, this instance is suited for large-scale databases, in-memory caching systems, enterprise resource planning applications, and memory-heavy data processing tasks.
